item.title: 美国数据中心融资遭贷款机构严审，社区反对声浪渐起
item.summary: NEW YORK, Aug 10 (Reuters) - The race to finance the U.S. data center boom is forcing banks and asset managers to confront an added risk: political and community opposition.
